comments.text: Quality loop findings — SELF-REVIEW: (1) Bug fixed: --inspect-index is deprecated, correct flag is --index (confirmed by live ntm deprecation warning). (2) JSON field refs (agent.state, output.last_lines) match actual ntm --robot-inspect-pane JSON shape. (3) ntm --robot-activity shape confirmed: agents[] with state field. (4) User-pane safety check correctly kept as tmux — no ntm flag reports pane_active/window_active; invariant preserved. (5) tmux send-keys kept for bare Enter and fg — no ntm equivalent for raw keystroke injection. (6) allowed-tools scoped to Bash(ntm *), Bash(tmux *) only. CROSS-REVIEW: coordination-watchdog-pattern and pane-send-protocol are consistent with rewrite. Other agent (957eb22) applied identical ntm rewrite before this session — both had --inspect-index bug, now corrected. RANDOM: ntm --robot-activity and --robot-inspect-pane both return clean JSON errors for nonexistent sessions; no error handling needed in skill.
